conceptZh: 棕是像棕熊毛皮的深褐色
object: a rubber dinosaur with giant feet and tiny arms, and a line of chocolate-brown toy blocks
morph: the dinosaur bumps one brown block and a domino chain tumbles into the strokes of 木 and 宗, forming 棕
creativeAngle: 橡膠恐龍手太短碰不到積木，只好用大腳輕輕一踢，連鎖倒下排成「棕」字；詞用「棕熊」。
promptEn: An 8-second 3D animated toy clip on a clean solid pale ivory backdrop, locked camera. The only text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 棕, centered in saturated chestnut-brown strokes about 70 percent of frame height, with the wood radical 木 on the left and the 宗 part on the right, a roof over a horizontal bar and a small 示 below. Cast: Dino, a squeaky green rubber dinosaur with enormous round feet and comically tiny arms that cannot reach anything, and a long line of upright brown toy domino blocks standing in a curving trail. Moment one, 0 to 1.8s: Dino waddles in, squeaking at every step, and stretches both tiny arms toward the first brown domino, which sits an inch beyond his fingertips, wiggling them hopelessly. The first 棕 is spoken as he reaches. Moment two, 1.8 to 3.4s: he gives up, lifts one giant foot to tap it, loses balance, hops on the other, and kicks the first block by accident with his big toe; the line of dominoes begins to clack down one after another across the floor. The second 棕 is spoken as the chain's first falling blocks form the vertical and bars of 木. Moment three, 3.4 to 5.0s: the dominoes race around a tight curve and cascade left to right, tumbling into a final layout that makes the roof, bar, and the small 示 of 宗 on the right side,; Dino holds up one tiny arm in triumph. Moment four, 5.0s onward: a small brown teddy-bear toy peeks over the edge, and Dino squeaks hello and gives it a bear hug with both short arms that barely wrap around anything. From 5.0 to 8.0s the glyph is perfectly still and uncovered while Dino and the little bear sway side by side at the bottom, swinging their tiny arms in a clumsy happy dance, never touching the strokes. Audio: a warm friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 「棕、棕、棕熊」, slowly with clear tones as ㄗㄨㄥ、ㄗㄨㄥ、ㄗㄨㄥ ㄒㄩㄥˊ. First 棕 near 0.7s, second near 2.4s, and 棕熊 around 5.3s as the little bear appears and is hugged. Stop after the word. Only soft clacks and squeaks, no background music. Soft studio lighting, vivid not neon colors, no flashing, no lens flare, no watermark, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, and no writing other than the single glyph 棕.
